originalTitle: Jim Cramer warns this overlooked danger could threaten the market rally
summary: CNBC’s Jim Cramer warned that a flood of massive IPOs could threaten the bull market's rally.
content:
CNBC's Jim Cramer warned Monday that a wave of massive initial public offerings and capital raises could threaten the bull market.

Anthropic , the company behind Claude, filed its IPO prospectus Monday, moving one of Wall Street's most anticipated public debuts a step closer. Investors have long awaited public offerings from AI leaders Anthropic and OpenAI , but Cramer said that their potentially massive fundraising needs could strain an already crowded market. With $148 billion raised through IPOs so far this year, he fears the influx of new shares could outstrip investor demand and derail the rally.

"Politics can weaken the bull, higher rates can choke it, but if you want to slay the darn thing, use the IPO lance and stab it again and again," the " Mad Money " host said. "It just gets weaker and weaker until it is weak enough to be slaughtered with the ease of a bad quarter, a rate hike and a run on the margin bank."

Cramer emphasized that his concerns aren't about the viability of AI itself. Unlike the speculative internet startups that collapsed during the dot-com bust in 2000, many of today's leading technology companies have established businesses and genuine demand for their products.

"This time around the companies are real. They tend to make big money. We trusted them before this moment. We will trust them after," he said.

But Cramer sees one troubling similarity between the two periods: the enormous amount of capital being raised. During the dot-com boom, a flood of stock offerings eventually exhausted investors' buying power, contributing to the market's collapse. Supply outpaced investor demand.

He fears a similar dynamic could emerge as companies including Meta , Alphabet , SpaceX and Oracle tap capital markets. Cramer warned that these massive fundraising efforts could absorb investor dollars that might otherwise flow into the S&P 500 and other stocks, putting pressure on the broader market even as corporate fundamentals remain strong. Cramer's Charitable Trust , the portfolio run by CNBC's Investing Club, owns shares of Meta and Alphabet.

"I think both the debt and the equity markets are running out of money," he said.

That means the market could run out of the money companies need to finance their ambitions before investors see the payoff. "I am not calling a top," he said. "I am just saying that I do not like what I see."

chineseTitle: 吉姆·克莱默警告说，这种被忽视的危险可能会威胁市场反弹
chineseSummary: CNBC 的吉姆·克莱默 (Jim Cramer) 警告称，大规模 IPO 的大量涌入可能会威胁牛市的反弹。
chineseContent:
CNBC 的吉姆·克莱默 (Jim Cramer) 周一警告称，大规模首次公开募股和融资浪潮可能会威胁牛市。

Claude 背后的公司 Anthropic 周一提交了 IPO 招股说明书，距离华尔街最受期待的公开上市又近了一步。投资者长期以来一直等待人工智能领导者 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 的公开发行，但 Cramer 表示，他们潜在的巨大融资需求可能会给本已拥挤的市场带来压力。今年迄今为止，通过首次公开募股筹集了 1,480 亿美元，他担心新股的涌入可能会超过投资者的需求，从而破坏股市的涨势。

“政治可以削弱牛市，更高的利率可以扼杀它，但如果你想杀死这该死的东西，请使用IPO长矛，一次又一次地刺它，”《疯狂金钱》主持人说。 “它只会变得越来越弱，直到弱到足以因糟糕的季度、加息和保证金银行挤兑而被屠杀。”

克莱默强调，他担心的不是人工智能本身的可行性。与 2000 年互联网泡沫破灭期间倒闭的投机性互联网初创公司不同，当今许多领先的科技公司已经建立了业务并对其产品产生了真正的需求。

“这一次，这些公司是真实的。他们往往会赚大钱。我们在此之前信任他们。之后我们也会信任他们，”他说。

但克莱默认为这两个时期有一个令人不安的相似之处：筹集的资金数额巨大。在互联网泡沫时期，大量的股票发行最终耗尽了投资者的购买力，导致市场崩溃。供应超过了投资者的需求。

他担心，随着 Meta、Alphabet、SpaceX 和 Oracle 等公司开拓资本市场，可能会出现类似的情况。克莱默警告说，这些大规模的融资活动可能会吸收投资者的资金，否则这些资金可能会流入标准普尔 500 指数和其他股票，从而给大盘带来压力，尽管企业基本面仍然强劲。 Cramer's Charitable Trust 是 CNBC 投资俱乐部运营的投资组合，拥有 Meta 和 Alphabet 的股票。

“我认为债务和股票市场的资金都在耗尽，”他说。

这意味着在投资者看到回报之前，市场可能会耗尽公司实现其雄心所需的资金。 “我不是在叫顶级，”他说。 “我只是说我不喜欢我所看到的。”
